monotone graph property.differences: a graph property is isomorphism-invariant and also closed under vertex removal; on edge sets vertex removal is a special edge removal, but RC.C0 does not require isomorphism invariance. Order-theoretic naming is reversed: Mathlib calls such a predicate Antitone, while Monotone means order-preserving.
